user.title: Link your Battery UP account
user.description: Sign in with your Battery UP account (the same one as the app). Home Assistant exchanges the password for a revocable access token and never stores the password itself.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-link Battery UP
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {email} was revoked or has become invalid. Enter the account password to mint a new one.

error.invalid_auth: Login refused — check the email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Battery UP service.

abort.already_configured: This Battery UP account is already configured.
